scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @recoveriq/shared && npx prisma generate --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build -w @recoveriq/shared && npx prisma generate --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build -w backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build -w @recoveriq/shared && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start:backend: npx prisma db push --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npx tsx backend/prisma/seed/index.ts && npm run start -w backend
